storemanager_contact_description: Store Manager — weekly reports and delivery alerts.
storemanager_bizmantab_shifthint: New hires need a desk shift here (BizMan → HQ → Schedule) before you can pick them.
storemanager_bizmantab_assignhint: New hires need to be assigned to this HQ before you can pick them.
storemanager_bizmantab_dayshelp: How many days of sales each shop should keep on the shelf. The manager orders enough to reach that — within the weekly budget.
storemanager_bizmantab_recruithow: Recruit a Store Manager through your phone → Recruitment Agency (pick this HQ, skill "Store Manager"), then give them a desk shift in BizMan → HQ → Schedule. They'll show up below.
storemanager_opt_role_disabled: The Store Manager role is disabled on this game build — supervision is paused and no data is lost. Existing plans load read-only.
storemanager_opt_recruit_hint: No eligible Store Manager. Recruit one via phone → Recruitment Agency, then schedule them on an HQ desk.
storemanager_opt_hqtab_hint: Manage your Store Managers from the "Store Managers" tab in your HQ's BizMan screen (next to Purchasing Agents / HR).
storemanager_opt_notab_hint: The HQ "Store Managers" tab isn't available on this game build — use the controls below.
storemanager_opt_def_days_help: How many days of sales a new store should keep on the shelf (the manager orders toward this, within budget).
storemanager_opt_uninstall_do: Re-skill managers to Purchasing Agent & drop plans
storemanager_msg_hired: {name} here — I'm your new Store Manager. Assign me some stores and set the budgets, and I'll keep them stocked.
storemanager_notify_store_lost: {store} left the manager's plan (no longer owned)
storemanager_notify_manager_gone: Your Store Manager is gone — their stores were released
storemanager_notify_dormant: Store Manager is idle — assign them to your HQ and give them a desk shift there to activate their plan
storemanager_notify_active: Store Manager is back on the job
storemanager_notify_budget_cap: {store}: hit the weekly restock budget cap
storemanager_notify_data_corrupt: Store Manager: saved data couldn't be read — running read-only this session (nothing will be overwritten)
storemanager_notify_role_disabled: Store Manager role disabled on this game build — supervision paused, no data lost
storemanager_msg_role_disabled: The Store Manager custom skill isn't safe on this game build ({reason}). Supervision is paused and existing plans load read-only — nothing is lost. If you're about to delete the mod, run "Safe uninstall" first.
